title: Lester learns to read better in his father's band
summary: Lester could read but his father made him read better; he played alto in the band and tenor on the carnival show.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone
